nativeResearchSpendingAuthorityAudit.uncoveredPaths: The pure Stage 3D contract could represent a known Research debit if the owner supplied an exact synchronous transaction with fresh current stock, complete known commitments, same-observation invocation, and native post-action reconciliation. None of those Research calls are integrated; native Research, passive production, Alchemy, queued/player commitments, and other actions can alter Mana outside Gather. Their debit path and action authority therefore remain unaccounted for here. Since the Stage 3I claims fence Gather only, these Research actions are not violations of an implemented Research-side allowance, but Rituals demonstrates the unresolved cross-owner gap while claims are active.
